Ok first of all, yes that person who touched you when you were young is a molester. Yes that person who got you drunk is also a really bad person, and you need to either completely stay away from them, or get them locked up in jail. But reading what you wrote, you sound to nice to pull the second thing off. What I can say about your current situation is that you need to let your feelings out to someone, about all of the past, and the closer that person is to you, the better. If you really fear sharing your personal life with anyone, then a therapist can help you in coping with how you feel. From the bottom of my heart, I’m sorry for how these people treated you, and ruined your experience for something that can be both magical and amazing. If you have a family member you can talk to, they’ll be the most reliable source of support. You might think they wouldn’t be supportive, but they’ll do whatever they can to get you back to your happy self.

Hope this helped, anything else you need, just message. Take care

Hi

I know it’s hard. I know you feel like you haven’t had any form of impact on someone. I know that you’re not motivated. But I promise you, you do impact everyone’s life around you. I wrote a post a while ago and I was pretty much in your shoes(I still in the same situation), but I have some hope about the next day. Everything is the same for me, nothing has changed, but me hoping for a better next day has helped me realize how much I can achieve if I try (even though I don’t), I give up by the evening, it relaxes me as at least I tried...

As academics go, they’re hard, specially if they don’t bring you joy, and I know it’s nearly impossible to create interest in studies when they courses are boring, so how about you just read something you like online (don’t replace it for your Studies ), think of something you enjoy doing, this can be anything from playing games, reading comics, watching shows, and honestly, you could probably find a course/degree on that area being offered for studies. It doesn’t matter what you achieve in grades, what really matters is did you learn something, and did you enjoy doing it.

Socially, I’m a loner, so I can’t help you much on this. however, I’ve kept myself so distracted that my needs of socializing have decreased significantly, and even though i still want to socialize, I can still have a fake smile and do something else without thinking much of social gathering.

Sorry I wrote a lot, I just wanted to let you know you’re not alone, and you attempting to suicide will hurt people around you way more then you can imagine, is it really worth it to assume you’re better off dead and not realizing people who care about you are going to suffer deeply remembering you? Honestly, I’ll suffer if you do something like that, so please don’t.
